name: Amount icon
description: Passive icon: two dots side by side — one more of everything. Port of the hand-drawn i_amount from Feelers' BootScene. Rim is `$bile`, the same as `ss.icon.wand`: this passive is the Spit evolution's other half, so the pair reads as a pair on the bar. The glyph wears the rim's colour as well, so the passive is one colour on the bar.
